items.title: Carmen Leggio interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: And Nick Brignola was on the Woody Herman band, that’s about it.

ctx.x: Yeah Sal. And Nick Brignola was on the Woody Herman band, that’s about it. That’s for you, what I left there. And Al Cohn’s wife Flo, she passed away, gave me that article.
If you were to look back on the albums you’ve recorded which was probably your favorite big band?
